content.json:
# AppGW → APIM → Azure AI Foundry — End-to-End Trace

Distributed trace waterfall stitched across three layers via **X-Correlation-Id**. Use this workbook to answer: *which LOB application made this call, how long did each layer take, and which Foundry backend was used?*

| Layer | Data Source | What it measures |
|---|---|---|
| **App Gateway WAF** | `AGWAccessLogs` (Log Analytics) | Total round-trip time seen by the client, including WAF inspection and TLS termination |
| **APIM Gateway** | `AppRequests` (App Insights) | Policy execution time (auth, quota check, caching, logging) + time waiting for Foundry to respond |
| **Azure AI Foundry** | `AppDependencies` (App Insights) | Model inference time at the AI backend only |

**How to use this workbook:**
1. Set the **Time Range** picker to the window of interest (default: last 4 hours)
2. Scroll to the **Summary tiles** to get a quick health check — total requests, avg latency per layer, error count
3. Use the **Traffic Flow** section to see which LOB subscriptions were active and which Foundry backend they hit
4. Use the **Latency Waterfall** to spot which layer is the bottleneck
5. Click any row in the routing table to populate the **Correlation ID** and see that specific request's per-layer breakdown

**How correlation works:** App Gateway stamps `X-Correlation-Id: clientIp-clientPort` on every forwarded request. APIM captures it as `Properties["Request-X-Correlation-Id"]` in App Insights. The AGW↔APIM join uses client IP + 2-second time bucket (App Gateway has no per-request UUID; TCP source port + client IP is unique within any live connection window).

> **Tip:** A **Subscription** filter at the top narrows all traffic charts to a single LOB subscription. To drill into a specific request, use the **Correlation ID** filter that appears above the trace table — or click any row in the routing table to auto-populate it.

### Summary tiles

At-a-glance health for the selected time window. These tiles only count requests that carry an `X-Correlation-Id` header (set by App Gateway on all forwarded requests).

| Tile | What it shows | Healthy range |
|---|---|---|
| **Total Requests** | Count of APIM-correlated requests; the sub-label shows average APIM latency | Growing over time = traffic is flowing |
| **Avg APIM Latency** | Mean time APIM spent processing each request (policy + Foundry round-trip) | < 3 000 ms for chat, < 500 ms for cached |
| **Avg Foundry Latency** | Mean model inference time at the Foundry backend | Depends on model; gpt-4o-mini ~500–2 000 ms |
| **Failed Requests** | Requests where APIM returned a non-2xx response | Should be 0 outside load-test windows |

content.query:
// Summary tiles: total volume and avg per-layer latency
let apimRequests = AppRequests
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| extend corrId = tostring(Properties["Request-X-Correlation-Id"])
| where isnotempty(corrId);
let foundryDeps = AppDependencies
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| extend corrId = tostring(Properties["Request-X-Correlation-Id"])
| where isnotempty(corrId);
union
  (apimRequests
   | summarize
       Value = toreal(count()),
       Sub   = strcat("avg ", round(avg(DurationMs), 0), " ms")
   | extend Metric = "Total Requests"),
  (apimRequests
   | summarize
       Value = round(avg(DurationMs), 0),
       Sub   = "milliseconds"
   | extend Metric = "Avg APIM Latency"),
  (foundryDeps
   | summarize
       Value = round(avg(DurationMs), 0),
       Sub   = "milliseconds"
   | extend Metric = "Avg Foundry Latency"),
  (apimRequests
   | where Success == false
   | summarize
       Value = toreal(count()),
       Sub   = "errors"
   | extend Metric = "Failed Requests")
| project Metric, Value, Sub
content.title: Traffic overview (APIM-correlated requests only)

content.query:
// Requests per APIM subscription over time — stacked bar
AppRequests
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| extend sub = tostring(Properties["Subscription Name"])
| where isnotempty(sub)
| where "{SubscriptionName}" == "value:all" or sub == "{SubscriptionName}"
| summarize Requests = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), sub
| sort by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Requests per subscription over time (5-min buckets) — stacked by APIM subscription key

content.query:
// Aggregate flow: Subscription -> Product -> Foundry backend
// Backend derived from Response-X-Backend-Region-Used logged by APIM outbound policy.
// More reliable than AppDependencies: APIM retry swallows the primary 429 so the
// primary backend call never appears as a dependency row.
AppRequests
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| extend sub       = tostring(Properties["Subscription Name"])
| extend prod      = tostring(Properties["Product Name"])
| extend backendRaw = tostring(Properties["Response-X-Backend-Region-Used"])
| where "{SubscriptionName}" == "value:all" or sub == "{SubscriptionName}"
| extend backend = case(
    backendRaw == "primary",            "Primary Foundry (East US)",
    backendRaw == "secondary-failover", "Secondary Foundry (West US)",
    isempty(backendRaw),                "(no backend call)",
    backendRaw == "unknown",            "⚠ APIM rejected (no backend reached)",
    backendRaw)
| summarize
    Requests          = count(),
    Errors            = countif(Success == false),
    ['Avg APIM (ms)'] = round(avg(DurationMs), 0)
    by sub, prod, backend
| extend ['Error %'] = round(100.0 * Errors / Requests, 1)
| sort by Requests desc
| project
    ['Subscription'] = sub,
    ['Product']      = prod,
    ['? Foundry']    = backend,
    Requests,
    Errors,
    ['Error %'],
    ['Avg APIM (ms)']
content.title: Subscription → Product → Foundry routing summary

content.query:
// Per-Foundry backend health: latency percentiles + error rate
// Uses Response-X-Backend-Region-Used from AppRequests so both primary and
// secondary-failover rows are visible (AppDependencies only captures final call).
AppRequests
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| extend backendRaw = tostring(Properties["Response-X-Backend-Region-Used"])
| where isnotempty(backendRaw)
| extend backend = case(
    backendRaw == "primary",            "Primary Foundry (East US)",
    backendRaw == "secondary-failover", "Secondary Foundry (West US)",
    backendRaw)
| summarize
    Requests     = count(),
    Errors       = countif(Success == false),
    ['Avg (ms)'] = round(avg(DurationMs), 0),
    ['p50 (ms)'] = round(percentile(DurationMs, 50), 0),
    ['p95 (ms)'] = round(percentile(DurationMs, 95), 0),
    ['p99 (ms)'] = round(percentile(DurationMs, 99), 0)
    by backend
| extend ['Error %'] = round(100.0 * Errors / Requests, 1)
| sort by Requests desc
| project
    ['Foundry Backend'] = backend,
    Requests,
    Errors,
    ['Error %'],
    ['Avg (ms)'],
    ['p50 (ms)'],
    ['p95 (ms)'],
    ['p99 (ms)']
content.title: Foundry backend health (latency + error rate)

content.json:
## Per-Layer Latency Waterfall

Breaks total end-to-end latency into three stacked components so you can see immediately which layer is the bottleneck.

**How to read this chart:**
- Each bar = one 5-minute bucket. The bar is divided into three coloured segments stacked from bottom to top
- 🟢 **Green (Foundry inference)** — time the AI model spent generating the response. This dominates for large prompts or slow models
- 🟠 **Orange (APIM overhead)** — APIM policy execution time after the Foundry response returns: logging, header injection, quota accounting. Should be < 50 ms
- 🔵 **Blue (App GW overhead)** — WAF inspection and TLS termination overhead. Note: currently 0 because the AGW→APIM timing join is approximate; drill into the per-request waterfall below for accurate per-request AGW data

> If the orange segment suddenly grows, check whether a policy (semantic cache miss, auth, quota) is adding latency. If green grows, the model is under load or a larger model was called.

content.query:
// Per-layer latency waterfall — stacked bar per time bucket
let apimReqs = AppRequests
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| extend corrId = tostring(Properties["Request-X-Correlation-Id"])
| where isnotempty(corrId)
| project TimeGenerated, corrId, apimDurationMs = DurationMs, opId = OperationId;
let foundryDeps = AppDependencies
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| extend corrId = tostring(Properties["Request-X-Correlation-Id"])
| where isnotempty(corrId)
| project corrId, foundryDurationMs = DurationMs, opId = OperationId;
let appgwLogs = AGWAccessLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| extend corrId = tostring(RequestUri)   // transactionId not always populated; use URI as fallback grouping
| project TimeGenerated, timeTakenMs = toreal(TimeTaken) * 1000;
apimReqs
| join kind=leftouter foundryDeps on opId
| extend foundryMs   = iff(isnotempty(foundryDurationMs), foundryDurationMs, 0.0)
| extend apimOverheadMs = max_of(apimDurationMs - foundryMs, 0.0)
| summarize
    avgAppgwMs      = 0.0,      // App GW timing joined separately — see note below
    avgApimOverheadMs = avg(apimOverheadMs),
    avgFoundryMs    = avg(foundryMs)
    by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| extend t = TimeGenerated
| project t, ['App GW overhead'] = avgAppgwMs, ['APIM overhead'] = avgApimOverheadMs, ['Foundry inference'] = avgFoundryMs
content.title: Avg latency per layer (5-min buckets)

content.json:
## Full App Gateway + APIM Join

The table below shows every individual request with all three layers joined. This is the most detailed view — use it to diagnose specific failures or to verify that AGW timing aligns with APIM timing.

**How the join works:** Client IP is extracted from the corrId (`clientIp-clientPort`) and matched against `AGWAccessLogs` within a 2-second time bucket centred on the APIM request start time. App Gateway does not expose a per-request UUID server variable, so TCP source port + client IP is used as a unique key within any active connection window.

**Column guide:**
- **Corr ID** — the `X-Correlation-Id` header value; click a row to populate the drilldown waterfall below
- **AGW HTTP / APIM HTTP / Foundry HTTP** — HTTP status at each layer (✅ = 2xx, ⚠️ = 4xx, ❌ = 5xx)
- **AGW (ms) / APIM (ms) / Foundry (ms)** — time spent in each layer; colour intensity reflects magnitude
- **Product** — Bronze/Silver/Gold tier that processed the request

> **Tip:** Sort by `Foundry (ms)` descending to find the slowest inference calls, or filter by `APIM HTTP = 429` to see rate-limited requests.

parameters.name: CorrelationId
parameters.label: Correlation ID (optional — filters trace table and drilldown)

typeSettings.placeholder: Paste a Correlation ID to isolate one request, or leave blank for all

content.query:
// Full 3-layer trace table: AGW ? APIM ? Foundry
// Each layer shows its own HTTP status code and response time.
// AGW join: approximate via clientIp + 2s time bucket (AGW has no per-request UUID).
let filter_corrId = "{CorrelationId}";
let apimRows = AppRequests
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| extend corrId = tostring(Properties["Request-X-Correlation-Id"])
| where isnotempty(corrId)
| where filter_corrId == "" or corrId == filter_corrId
| project
    corrId,
    opId             = OperationId,
    apimStart        = TimeGenerated,
    apimDurationMs   = DurationMs,
    apimStatus       = ResultCode,
    url              = Url,
    apimProduct      = tostring(Properties["Product Name"]),
    apimSubscription = tostring(Properties["Subscription Name"]),
    backendUsed      = tostring(Properties["Response-X-Backend-Region-Used"]);
let foundryRows = AppDependencies
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| extend corrId = tostring(Properties["Request-X-Correlation-Id"])
| where isnotempty(corrId)
| where filter_corrId == "" or corrId == filter_corrId
| summarize
    foundryDurationMs = avg(DurationMs),
    foundryStatus     = any(ResultCode),
    foundryTarget     = any(Target)
    by corrId, opId = OperationId;
let agwRows = AGWAccessLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| project
    agwDurationMs    = toreal(TimeTaken) * 1000,
    agwStatus        = HttpStatus,
    agwClientIp      = ClientIp,
    agwKey           = strcat(ClientIp, "~", tostring(bin(TimeGenerated, 2s)));
apimRows
| join kind=leftouter foundryRows on opId
| extend corrClientIp = tostring(split(corrId, "-")[0])
| extend approxKey    = strcat(corrClientIp, "~", tostring(bin(apimStart, 2s)))
| join kind=leftouter agwRows on $left.approxKey == $right.agwKey
| project-away corrClientIp, approxKey, agwKey
| sort by isnotnull(foundryDurationMs) desc, apimStart desc
| project
    Time             = apimStart,
    ['Corr ID']      = corrId,
    ['URL']          = url,
    ['AGW HTTP']     = agwStatus,
    ['AGW (ms)']     = round(agwDurationMs, 1),
    ['APIM HTTP']    = apimStatus,
    ['APIM (ms)']    = round(apimDurationMs, 1),
    ['Foundry Backend']= iff(isempty(backendUsed), 'primary', backendUsed),
    ['Foundry HTTP'] = foundryStatus,
    ['Foundry (ms)'] = round(foundryDurationMs, 1),
    ['Product']      = apimProduct,
    ['Subscription'] = apimSubscription,
    ['Client IP']    = agwClientIp
content.title: Per-request trace table (AppGW + APIM + Foundry)

content.json:
## P50 / P95 / P99 Latency by Layer

Shows the statistical distribution of latency in each layer for the selected time window. Percentiles reveal tail latency that averages hide.

**How to read this table:**
- **p50** (median) — half of requests complete faster than this. Represents the typical user experience
- **p95** — 95% of requests complete faster than this. Represents what a busy user experiences
- **p99** — 99% completion threshold. Represents worst-case latency that SLAs are often measured against
- **APIM overhead** — policy execution time only (auth, quota, logging), excluding Foundry wait time
- **Foundry inference** — model generation time only
- **Total APIM** — full round-trip as seen by APIM (overhead + Foundry)

> A large gap between p50 and p99 on **Foundry inference** = the model is occasionally slow (prompt length variance, cold start, or throttling). A large p99 on **APIM overhead** = a policy is occasionally stalling (e.g. cache miss causing a synchronous lookup).

content.query:
let apimReqs = AppRequests
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| extend corrId = tostring(Properties["Request-X-Correlation-Id"])
| where isnotempty(corrId)
| project corrId, apimDurationMs = DurationMs, opId = OperationId;
let foundryDeps = AppDependencies
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| extend corrId = tostring(Properties["Request-X-Correlation-Id"])
| where isnotempty(corrId)
| summarize foundryMs = avg(DurationMs) by corrId;
apimReqs
| join kind=leftouter foundryDeps on corrId
| extend foundryMs        = iff(isnotempty(foundryMs), foundryMs, 0.0)
| extend apimOverheadMs   = max_of(apimDurationMs - foundryMs, 0.0)
| summarize
    ['APIM overhead p50']    = round(percentile(apimOverheadMs,  50), 1),
    ['APIM overhead p95']    = round(percentile(apimOverheadMs,  95), 1),
    ['APIM overhead p99']    = round(percentile(apimOverheadMs,  99), 1),
    ['Foundry inference p50']= round(percentile(foundryMs,       50), 1),
    ['Foundry inference p95']= round(percentile(foundryMs,       95), 1),
    ['Foundry inference p99']= round(percentile(foundryMs,       99), 1),
    ['Total APIM p50']       = round(percentile(apimDurationMs,  50), 1),
    ['Total APIM p95']       = round(percentile(apimDurationMs,  95), 1),
    ['Total APIM p99']       = round(percentile(apimDurationMs,  99), 1)
| project Stat = "Latency (ms)",
    ['APIM overhead p50'], ['APIM overhead p95'], ['APIM overhead p99'],
    ['Foundry inference p50'], ['Foundry inference p95'], ['Foundry inference p99'],
    ['Total APIM p50'], ['Total APIM p95'], ['Total APIM p99']
content.title: Latency percentiles by layer (ms)

content.json:
## WAF Firewall Events

Requests **inspected by the Application Gateway WAF** (OWASP CRS 3.2 + Bot Manager). The WAF runs before APIM — requests blocked here never reach APIM and will not appear in the App Insights tables above.

**How to read this table:**
- **Blocked** — requests the WAF actively rejected with HTTP 403. Legitimate traffic should never appear here; if it does, the rule may be a false positive
- **Matched** — requests that triggered a WAF rule but were *allowed through* in Detection mode. High values here warrant reviewing whether the rule should be promoted to Prevention mode
- **Rule Set / Rule ID / Message** — the specific OWASP or Bot Manager rule that fired

> During normal AI API usage (JSON POST bodies with prompt text), certain OWASP rules for SQL injection or XSS may produce false positives on prompt content. Use the Rule ID to look up the rule and decide whether to exclude the specific URI path.

content.query:
AGWFirewallLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize
    Blocked = countif(Action == "Blocked"),
    Matched = countif(Action == "Matched"),
    Total   = count()
    by RuleSetType, RuleId, Message
| sort by Blocked desc, Total desc
| project
    ['Rule Set']  = RuleSetType,
    ['Rule ID']   = RuleId,
    Message,
    Blocked,
    Matched,
    Total
content.title: WAF rule matches / blocks

content.json:
## Request Routing Flow

Shows every individual request: which **APIM product tier** it came from, which **Foundry backend** it was routed to, and the latency at each hop. This table is the gateway to the per-request drilldown waterfall below.

**How to read this table:**
- **Product** — colour-coded tier: 🟤 Bronze / ⚪ Silver / 🟡 Gold
- **→ Foundry** — which backend processed the request: `Primary (East US)` under normal conditions, `Secondary (West US)` when the circuit breaker has tripped
- **AGW / APIM ovhd / Foundry (ms)** — time in each layer; colour intensity reflects magnitude (orange = moderate, red = high)
- **Total (ms)** — full round-trip as seen by the App Gateway
- **HTTP / OK** — status code icon (✅ 2xx, ⚠️ 4xx, ❌ 5xx)

> **Click any row** to populate the **Correlation ID** parameter and see that request's per-layer waterfall in the panel below.

content.query:
// Request routing flow: Client ? APIM Product ? Foundry Backend
// Exact AGW join: corrId = "clientIp-clientPort" matches AGWAccessLogs ClientIp + ClientPort
let filter_corrId = "{CorrelationId}";
let apim = AppRequests
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| extend corrId          = tostring(Properties["Request-X-Correlation-Id"])
| extend apimProduct     = tostring(Properties["Product Name"])
| extend apimSub         = tostring(Properties["Subscription Name"])
| extend apiName         = tostring(Properties["API Name"])
| where isnotempty(corrId)
| where filter_corrId == "" or corrId == filter_corrId
| project apimTime=TimeGenerated, corrId, OperationId, apimDurationMs=DurationMs,
          apimStatus=ResultCode, apimSuccess=Success, apimProduct, apimSub, apiName, Url;
let foundry = AppDependencies
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| extend corrId = tostring(Properties["Request-X-Correlation-Id"])
| where isnotempty(corrId)
| where filter_corrId == "" or corrId == filter_corrId
| project OperationId, foundryDurationMs=DurationMs,
          foundryTarget=Target, foundryStatus=ResultCode, foundrySuccess=Success;
let agw = AGWAccessLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| extend corrId = strcat(ClientIp, "-", tostring(ClientPort))
| where filter_corrId == "" or corrId == filter_corrId
| project agwTime=TimeGenerated, corrId,
          agwTotalMs = toreal(TimeTaken) * 1000,
          agwStatus=HttpStatus, agwClient=ClientIp;
apim
| join kind=leftouter (foundry) on OperationId
| join kind=leftouter (agw) on corrId
| extend foundryHost = tostring(split(foundryTarget, "/")[2])
| extend foundryRegion = case(
    foundryHost contains "primary",   "Primary (East US)",
    foundryHost contains "secondary", "Secondary (West US)",
    foundryHost)
| extend apimOverheadMs = max_of(apimDurationMs - iff(isnotempty(foundryDurationMs), foundryDurationMs, 0.0), 0.0)
| extend agwOverheadMs  = max_of(agwTotalMs - apimDurationMs, 0.0)
| sort by isnotnull(foundryDurationMs) desc, apimTime desc
| project
    Time              = apimTime,
    ['Corr ID']       = corrId,
    ['Client IP']     = agwClient,
    ['Product']       = apimProduct,
    ['Subscription']  = apimSub,
    ['? APIM']        = 'apim-contoso-vdls2xyq',
    ['? Foundry']     = foundryRegion,
    ['AGW (ms)']      = round(agwOverheadMs, 1),
    ['APIM ovhd (ms)']= round(apimOverheadMs, 1),
    ['Foundry (ms)']  = round(foundryDurationMs, 1),
    ['Total (ms)']    = round(agwTotalMs, 1),
    ['HTTP']          = apimStatus,
    ['OK']            = apimSuccess
content.title: Request routing: Client → APIM → Foundry backend

content.json:
## Per-Request Waterfall

Click any row in the routing table above to populate the **Correlation ID** parameter. This panel then renders a **3-layer horizontal bar chart** for that specific connection — proportional to time spent in each layer.

**How to read this chart:**
- Each horizontal bar = one request. The bar is divided into three segments in call order (left → right)
- 🔵 **App Gateway (ms)** — WAF inspection + TLS termination overhead before the request reached APIM
- 🟠 **APIM overhead (ms)** — APIM policy execution time (auth, quota check, logging, header injection) *excluding* the time waiting for Foundry
- 🟢 **Foundry inference (ms)** — the AI model's actual generation time
- Row label format: `HH:mm:ss [product] [backend] [total ms]` — allows comparing requests at the same timestamp

> **No Corr ID set?** The chart shows all requests in the time window (up to 50 rows). Set the Correlation ID to isolate a single connection.

content.query:
// Per-request waterfall: 3-layer horizontal bars
// Each row = one request. Columns = time in each layer, stacked.
let filter_corrId = "{CorrelationId}";
let apim = AppRequests
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| extend corrId       = tostring(Properties["Request-X-Correlation-Id"])
| extend apimProduct  = tostring(Properties["Product Name"])
| where isnotempty(corrId)
| where filter_corrId == "" or corrId == filter_corrId
| project apimTime=TimeGenerated, corrId, OperationId,
          apimDurationMs=DurationMs, apimStatus=ResultCode, apimProduct;
let foundry = AppDependencies
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| extend corrId = tostring(Properties["Request-X-Correlation-Id"])
| where isnotempty(corrId)
| where filter_corrId == "" or corrId == filter_corrId
| project OperationId, foundryDurationMs=DurationMs,
          foundryTarget=Target;
let agw = AGWAccessLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| extend corrId = strcat(ClientIp, "-", tostring(ClientPort))
| where filter_corrId == "" or corrId == filter_corrId
| project corrId, agwTotalMs = toreal(TimeTaken) * 1000;
apim
| join kind=leftouter (foundry) on OperationId
| join kind=leftouter (agw) on corrId
| extend foundryMs      = iff(isnotempty(foundryDurationMs), foundryDurationMs, 0.0)
| extend agwTotal       = iff(isnotempty(agwTotalMs), agwTotalMs, apimDurationMs)
| extend apimOverheadMs = max_of(apimDurationMs - foundryMs, 0.0)
| extend agwOverheadMs  = max_of(agwTotal - apimDurationMs, 0.0)
| extend foundryHost    = tostring(split(foundryTarget, "/")[2])
| extend backend        = case(
    foundryHost contains "primary",   "? Primary",
    foundryHost contains "secondary", "? Secondary",
    "? Foundry")
| extend rowLabel = strcat(
    format_datetime(apimTime, "HH:mm:ss"),
    " ", apimProduct,
    " ", backend,
    " [", tostring(round(agwTotal,0)), "ms]")
| project
    rowLabel,
    ['App Gateway (ms)'] = round(agwOverheadMs, 1),
    ['APIM overhead (ms)'] = round(apimOverheadMs, 1),
    ['Foundry inference (ms)'] = round(foundryMs, 1)
| sort by rowLabel asc
| limit 50
content.title: Per-request latency waterfall — click a row above to filter by Correlation ID

content.json:
---

**Tip:** The **Correlation ID** parameter box at the top also accepts manual input � paste a value from the trace table `Corr ID` column to isolate a specific client connection across all panels above.
